summary: Frontend-only validation of Valkeyry iPaaS Admin Console (4-tab React UI). Spring backend intentionally unreachable per request. All 11 requested UI scenarios verified via Playwright: rendering, navigation, localStorage persistence, form validation, live YAML preview, multi-row add/remove, and graceful error toasts when backend calls fail. All data-testid selectors resolved correctly. Design tokens (IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono, #0b1220 background, no purple/violet) confirmed.

integration_issues.flow: Multi-Tenant Publish submit with filled row 0
integration_issues.issue: When the backend at http://localhost:8080 is unreachable, the fetch is blocked by the browser's private/loopback CORS policy. The catch path correctly surfaces a sonner error toast, but the toast text is the raw browser exception 'Failed to execute postMessage on Window: Request object could not be cloned.' rather than the user-friendly 'multiPublish: <status>' message defined in ipaasClient.js (because the fetch never returns a Response; it throws a TypeError before .ok is read). Functionally OK (no crash, toast does appear) but the user-facing message is noisy. Consider wrapping fetch in try/catch inside api.multiPublish (and other api.* methods) to normalize the error string, e.g. `throw new Error('multiPublish: network unreachable')`.

integration_issues.flow: Metrics Start stream after Load sample
integration_issues.issue: EventSource fails immediately (CORS to localhost:8080 from preview origin). The stop()->setStreaming(false) handler is invoked from onerror so the button only briefly flips to 'Stop' and then reverts to 'Start stream'. This matches the review-request acceptance criteria ('SSE-error toast may appear — acceptable') but means the metrics-stop-btn was not stably observable in the snapshot we took ~2.5s after click. No fix required for this sandbox; just noting for future test agents.

action_items: Optional polish: in /app/frontend/src/lib/ipaasClient.js, wrap fetch() calls (multiPublish, browseDlq, etc.) with try/catch to convert network/TypeError into a friendly message before the sonner toast renders it. Currently the raw browser exception ('Failed to execute postMessage on Window...') leaks through in the unreachable-backend path.
critical_code_review_comments: ipaasClient.js: fetch() calls do not catch network errors (TypeError thrown when host is unreachable or CORS-blocked). The string surfaced to toast.error(e.message) is then the browser's internal message rather than the controlled 'multiPublish: <status>' string. Recommend a small helper that normalizes errors.

MetricsPanel.openMetricsStream: passes the bearer token via query string in a comment but the current implementation does NOT actually append the token; if/when the Spring backend enables auth this stream will be anonymous-only. Acceptable for dev with ipaas.security.allow-anonymous=true, but flag for production.
TopBar useEffect dependency array omits setCtx (React hooks/exhaustive-deps lint would warn). Functionally fine because setCtx is stable from useState, but worth adding for cleanliness.

ipaasClient.js BASE_URL falls back to http://localhost:8080 when REACT_APP_IPAAS_BASE_URL is unset. In the preview deployment this becomes a hard-coded default; consider failing fast in prod builds instead of silently defaulting.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleared localStorage keys 'valkeyry.bearer-token' and 'valkeyry.context' at test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend (Spring Boot on :8080) is NOT runnable in this sandbox - all backend calls will CORS-fail from the preview origin. That is intentional. When validating UI, treat any non-network sonner toast as the source of truth for error handling. localStorage keys: 'valkeyry.bearer-token' (token), 'valkeyry.context' (JSON with tenantId/projectId). Sample UUIDs auto-populated by Load sample: tenant=valkeyry-preview, project=valkeyry-preview. All data-testid selectors used in the request resolve correctly on the live preview URL.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - no bug to root-cause. The single quirk observed (raw browser exception text in MP submit toast) is documented under action_items.
